capabilities: Switch vaults in the current window
Move the new window to the old window's position, size and maximized state
Reload a window in place into another vault
Fall back to seamless handoff when Obsidian internals change
extras: Desktop only. The in-place swap mode is marked experimental, relies on undocumented Obsidian internals and Electron APIs, and has listed side effects; the plugin makes no network calls and collects no telemetry.
intentEvidence: By default, Obsidian's vault switcher opens every vault in a new window and leaves the old one behind.
problem: Obsidian's built-in vault switcher opens each chosen vault in a new window and leaves the previous window behind.
summary: Plugin that makes Obsidian's vault switcher replace the current window's vault instead of opening a new window.
